name: ts-lsp
description: TypeScript-only LSP via vtsls, with LSP-first enforcement hooks

enforce_search.title: Enforce LSP over text search (TypeScript)
enforce_search.description: Redirect Grep/Glob/Bash-grep for TypeScript code symbols to the LSP tool. Fail-open: disabled only when set to false.

enforce_read_gate.title: Progressive read gate (TypeScript)
enforce_read_gate.description: Require an LSP navigation call before reading many TypeScript files (warmup -> surgical mode). Creates per-project state; fail-closed: active only when explicitly true.
